title: platform.attention.publish input
description: An attention item the owner is asked to consent to before it is sent. It never runs from the conversation loop: a call becomes an effect batch the owner approves or refuses (nestor-effect-consent-loop).

title.description: What the notification says, in one short line.

summary.description: Optional detail shown with the item.

urgency.description: How insistent the item is. CRITICAL stays a human decision and is not offered.

rationale.description: Why this should be sent now. The owner reads this sentence before consenting, so it is required.
